I implemented the `initials` field following the existing `displayName` pattern exactly, keeping structural impact minimal by touching only two files and adding no new complexity to any method:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added an `initials` read-only string property to the `Owner` schema (right beside the existing `displayName`), which regenerates the `OwnerDto` with the new field.

   ```

For `firstName="john"`, `lastName="smith"` this yields `"J.S."`. `firstName`/`lastName` are `@NotEmpty`, so `substring(0,1)` is always safe. No method bodies grew and no cyclomatic complexity was added — the change is a declarative annotation plus a schema property.
